title: Solar Odyssey: a browser space game built entirely by Claude Opus 5.5, with Blender-generated ships, shader planets and a gravitationally lensed black hole
author: Loud-Current1641
selftext:
**Play:** [https://junzzy827.github.io/solar-odyssey/?lang=en](https://junzzy827.github.io/solar-odyssey/?lang=en) · **Source:** [https://github.com/Junzzy827/solar-odyssey](https://github.com/Junzzy827/solar-odyssey)

I'm not a game dev. Everything comes from conversation with Claude Opus 5.5:

* **Ships:** 6 hulls generated by Python scripts driving headless Blender, with panel detail, roughness and window maps baked in Blender. The bridge interior is a Blender room with baked lighting.
* **Rendering:** Three.js / React Three Fiber, ACES tone mapping, SSAO, bloom and film grain (each can be toggled), plus adaptive quality for weak laptops.
* **Planets:** Real textures (CC BY 4.0) plus shaders for flowing clouds, ring shadows and close-up craters. There's a "photographic" look with limb darkening and atmospheric scattering.
* **Black hole:** A lensing shader that wraps the far side of the accretion disk over the top and under the bottom.
* **Audio:** An original orchestral loop synthesized in Python.

Still in progress, so feedback is very welcome.
